home.title: Bhote Koshi flood help | npflood.org
home.description: Bhote Koshi / Bhotekoshi flood tools for Rasuwa and Kerung / Gyirong: emergency numbers, I am safe, looking for family, prepare a message you send yourself.
home.lede: What do you need? Choose one. You are not registered here, and we do not keep a list.

status.title: Flood status and emergency phones | npflood.org
status.description: Nepal Police 100, fire 101, ambulance 102, Bipad Helpline 1234, and National Emergency Operation Centre 1149 for the Bhote Koshi flood. Other official lines are listed only when confirmed.
status.lede: These numbers are confirmed. More official lines will be added when they exist.

find.title: Looking for someone in Nepal | npflood.org
find.description: If you are in Nepal looking for someone after the Bhote Koshi flood, prepare a note and take it to police, a hospital, or a ward office. This site cannot find anyone.
find.lede: This site cannot find a person. We have no list. Prepare the details below and take them to police, a hospital, or a ward office.

consular.title: Looking for family from abroad | npflood.org
consular.description: If you are abroad looking for family after the Bhote Koshi flood, prepare a note and take it to your embassy or ICRC family links.
consular.lede: You are abroad. Take these details to your embassy or to ICRC Restoring Family Links. We will not invent embassy numbers.

help.title: Volunteer and donate | npflood.org
help.description: How to help after the Bhote Koshi flood. Official donation links, and volunteer coordinators when confirmed.
help.lede: We do not take volunteer sign-ups. Donation links below go to official organisations. This site does not take money.

faq.a: No. This site does not keep a list of people. You are not registered here.

faq.q: Can this site find a missing person?
faq.a: No. Prepare a note and take it to police, a hospital, a ward office, your embassy, or ICRC Restoring Family Links.
Nepal Police 100, fire 101, ambulance 102, Bipad Helpline 1234, National Emergency Operation Centre 1149. Other official lines appear on Status only when confirmed.

faq.q: What do I do with the message this site prepares?
faq.a: Give or send it yourself on paper, SMS, WhatsApp, or WeChat. There is no inbox here.

statusHazard: If you are on the Bhote Koshi or Trishuli floodplain, sleep on high ground. A landslide-formed lake upstream could breach. Follow DHM and NDRRMA warnings only, not forwarded messages, including this page.
outOfContact: Out of contact does not mean dead. Roads and phone lines are down. Most people listed as missing are alive and unreachable.
statusBody: For the Bhote Koshi (Bhotekoshi) flood and the Rasuwa / Kerung area. Numbers can change. Prefer what a local official tells you on the ground.

findBody: A police post or the nearest police office. Dial 100.
The nearest hospital or health post.
The ward office, municipality, or district administration office.
consularBody: Call your own country's embassy or consulate. They may have a flood desk.
For Nepali families, watch official Nepal government notices and the Consulate General in Lhasa. Their number will appear on Status when it is confirmed.
findListsDisclaimer: These sites are not npflood.org. This site cannot look anyone up. We have no list.
findListPolice: Nepal Police missing and unidentified registers
findListPmo: Government rescue request portal (Office of the Prime Minister). Their counts are theirs, not ours.
dnaTitle: If photo identification is not possible
dnaBody: The Government of Nepal facilitates DNA matching where photo ID fails or remains are temporarily interred. First-degree relatives can send DNA profiles or give blood samples.
consularRemains: A published nine-step process exists for returning foreign nationals' remains, coordinated through embassies. Ask your own embassy. This site does not list the steps.
helpBody: Share the status page and this site. Do not spread unconfirmed numbers.
Only trust official organisations for blood, clothes, or money.
Do not travel to the flood area to help unless an official coordinator asked you to. Unrequested arrivals use helicopter seats that injured people need.

helpDonations.pmdrf: Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund (official government)

helpHeldBody: Volunteer coordinators will be listed here only when confirmed. This site does not take volunteer sign-ups.
trekGuidance: This is for agency staff. There is no lock on the page. If the party is safe or the location changes, write that the same way you sent the first note.
